# Six exact numerical witnesses

Build 13 passes all 1605 unchanged C07 assertions for each of six cases:
515 tokens at 64/128 rows, 470-token partial terminal at 64/128 rows, and
515 tokens with an exact 17-token reused prefix at 64/128 rows. Every recorded
candidate tensor/logit/routing drift is exactly zero in all six witnesses.
The 256-row reference, 512-row rechunk control, repeated candidate, teacher
continuations and speculative rollback criteria remain unchanged.

Commands: `slotstream optimization-state-check --variant <case> --json`,
with the exact case names reflected in the raw sections below. Timings and
capacity interpretations are excluded because these bounded correctness runs
overlap a separately coordinated anonymous model download.

These witnesses do not close P4: the next one-row-tail witness fails, and
sparse-indexer/reused-prefix cases remain unrun. No capacity ladder, public
limit increase, real-client acceptance or release is claimed.
